_direction: comb is this volume's own, and it owns the colour of the whole wrap rather than only the front. The back panel's content is the series' — the same blurb, claims and foot, quoted from _shared and not copied — but it is set in comb's palette, which needs no markup because every rule on that panel reads a token. The deep half below the curve and the spine both take the front's green, so the colour runs from the front round the shelf edge into the foot of the back and the one light area left is the upper back, where the words are. No finish is declared: on a direction the finish is inert, because .jacket--comb sets the same tokens the finish blocks set and wins the cascade by coming later in cover.css. night, solar, cobalt and vivid all rendered a byte-identical proof of the arc version of this cover, which is how that was found.
_spine: No spineWidth is declared here, and that is deliberate. pages is now measured rather than guessed: a --book run of class-8 comes to 229 leaves (three of front matter and 226 numbered), rounded up to 232 for a multiple of four. At 0.106mm the block bulks to 12.3mm and the case takes it to 12.8, which is what the builder computes and prints. Class 9 overrides its own arithmetic with a printer-quoted 15mm on a stock the caliper here does not describe; if this volume goes to the same press on the same paper its spine is nearer 14.8 than 12.8, so get the quote and set spineWidth before the wrap goes to press. Re-derive pages from --book whenever a chapter changes length.
